question: Magkano ang porsyento ng Basic Real Property Tax at Special Education Fund sa Davao City?
answer: The Basic Real Property Tax in Davao City is levied at a rate of 1.5% of the assessed value of real property, as stated in [S7]. The Special Education Fund (SEF) is levied an additional 1% tax on the assessed value of real property, as stated in [S1] and [S8].
